items.source:
Return whether we're defaulting Java primitives in the case of mapping a null value from corresponding database
fields.
items.translation: 返回在将来自对应数据库字段的 null 值映射时，我们是否默认使用了 Java 基本类型。

items.source: Set whether we're strictly validating that all bean properties have been mapped from corresponding database fields.
items.translation: 设置是否严格验证所有 Bean 属性是否已从对应的数据库字段映射。

items.source: Set the class that each row should be mapped to.
items.translation: 设置每行应映射到的类。

items.source:
Set whether we're defaulting Java primitives in the case of mapping a null value from corresponding database
fields.
items.translation: 设置是否在将来自对应数据库字段的 null 值映射为 Java 基本类型时采用默认值。

items.source: For 'null' values read from the database, we will attempt to call the setter, but in the case of Java primitives, this causes a TypeMismatchException. This class can be configured (using the primitivesDefaultedForNullValue property) to trap this exception and use the primitives default value. Be aware that if you use the values from the generated bean to update the database the primitive value will have been set to the primitive's default value instead of null.
items.translation: 对于从数据库读取的 'null' 值，我们将尝试调用 setter；但在 Java 基本类型的情况下，这会引发 TypeMismatchException。该类可以通过配置（使用 primitivesDefaultedForNullValue 属性）来捕获此异常并使用基本类型的默认值。请注意，如果您使用生成的 Bean 中的值来更新数据库，基本类型的值将被设置为该基本类型的默认值，而不是 null。

items.source: Default is a DefaultConversionService. This provides support for java.time conversion and other special types.
items.translation: 默认值为DefaultConversionService。它支持java.time转换以及其他特殊类型。

items.source: Please note that this class is designed to provide convenience rather than high performance. For best performance, consider using a custom RowMapper implementation.
items.translation: 请注意，此类的目的是提供便利性而非高性能。若要获得最佳性能，请考虑使用自定义的RowMapper实现。

items.source: The default implementation applies the configured ConversionService, if any. Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 默认实现会应用配置的 ConversionService（如果有的话）。可以在子类中重写此行为。

items.source: The default implementation calls GettableByIndex.get(int, Class). Subclasses may override this to check specific value types upfront, or to post-process values return from get.
items.translation: 默认实现会调用GettableByIndex.get(int, Class)。子类可以重写此方法，以便提前检查特定的值类型，或对从get返回的值进行后处理。

items.source: Mapping is provided for fields in the target class for many common types, e.g.: String, boolean, Boolean, byte, Byte, short, Short, int, Integer, long, Long, float, Float, double, Double, BigDecimal, java.util.Date, etc.
items.translation: 为许多常见类型（例如：String、boolean、Boolean、byte、Byte、short、Short、int、Integer、long、Long、float、Float、double、Double、BigDecimal、java.util.Date 等）的目标类字段提供了映射。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to GettableByIndex.get(int, Class).
items.translation: 默认实现会委托给GettableByIndex.get(int, Class)。

items.source:
Column values are mapped based on matching the column name as obtained from result set meta-data to public setters
for the corresponding properties. The names are matched either directly or by transforming a name separating the
parts with underscores to the same name using "camel" case.
items.translation: 列值将根据结果集元数据中获取的列名与对应属性的公共 setter 进行映射。名称匹配方式有两种：直接匹配，或将使用下划线分隔各部分名称转换为"驼峰”式命名后匹配。

items.source:
To facilitate mapping between columns and fields that don't have matching names, try using column aliases in the CQL
statement like "select fname as first_name from customer".
items.translation: 为便于映射名称不匹配的列和字段，请在 CQL 语句中使用列别名，例如："select fname as first_name from customer"。

items.source: Default is false, accepting unpopulated properties in the target bean.
items.translation: 默认值为 false，允许目标 Bean 中存在未填充的属性。

items.source: Default is false, throwing an exception when nulls are mapped to Java primitives.
items.translation: 默认值为 false，当将空值映射到 Java 基本类型时会抛出异常。

items.translation: 使用公共设置器和结果集元数据。
